id: HT-TG-02 (test mode on a test stage: STORE_TEST_MODE=1 and the runner's marker turn the STORE_TEST_* switches on, as every helper case relies on)
note: Review of 0.1.17 (pre-existing): STORE_TEST_MODE=1 alone turned every test switch on in a normal run; STORE_TEST_NOW let prune list and delete young evidence and stopped handoff citations protecting files, STORE_TEST_OS and STORE_TEST_CYGDRIVE changed path reading. helper/lib/testgate.pm now needs STORE_TEST_MODE=1 and the marker .store-test-stage at the root of the plugin copy the helper runs from (only the test stagers write it; tools/gates test-stage fails a plugin that holds one). This case is the control: the same steps on a staged copy with the marker.
